newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares seen higher with Bel-20 up 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares seen higher with Bel-20 up 0.5 pct.

text.p: 0730 GMT - Belgian shares to rise again, supported by dollar and Wall Street's .DJI further gains on Friday.
* Bel-20 index .BFX to gain at least 0.5 percent from Friday's record close at 2,400.36 points.
* First day of trade in shares in shoe distribution company Brantano, whose IPO priced at 1,120 francs was several times oversubscribed. Bid/ask prices seen so far in 1,120 to 1,296 franc range.
